summary: Re-verify. UX-N1 (dead .chs-readmode--ro modifier) is now resolved: the modifier is defined in rights-admin.css as an info-tinted pill using theme tokens (color:var(--chs-color-info); background:var(--chs-color-info-soft); token-based radius/spacing), matching the .chs-actchip--narrow / .chs-chip--running convention. Both tokens are real (used across components.css). Badge «только просмотр» is now visually distinct from the neutral .chs-readmode base and reads in both themes. Original approved UX verdict stands; the one non-blocker is cleared.

checks.note: rights-admin.css:552-563 — info pill via var(--chs-color-info)/var(--chs-color-info-soft), radius/padding from tokens. Dot recolored to info. No hardcoded hex. 3 new source-presence tests in screen-rights.test.jsx assert the class is applied AND defined AND uses an accent token (not a dead class).

checks.item: AC1.1 visible reason on topbar + grant-trail stubs, both themes
checks.note: unchanged from prior review; still token-based (chs-topbar__hint / chs-trail__stubhint = --chs-color-text-muted).

checks.item: Two honest empty-states for export (REV-N1 UX side)
checks.note: «нет записей» when no rows at all vs «нет совпадений фильтра» when a filter matches nothing — the disabled stub now tells the truth about WHY it is empty (previously it said «нет записей» even when displayRows was non-empty). Good honest-cause UX.

non_blocking.finding: «логин не задан» still uses inline style fontStyle:italic rather than a token-backed class. Consistent with the surrounding inline-styled block; cosmetic, not a regression.
